title: Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting
desc: Clicks "Open" on the gate lighting ticket
structure: The topbar differs from screen 17: it opens with a bare inline-styled div (34px square, border-radius 50%, background var(--navy-100), flex-centred) holding a 16px chevron-left SVG coloured var(--navy-700), then the <h1> "Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting". There is no .top-right block on this screen. The .content block holds three siblings in order. (1) .ticket-head — a flex row, gap 18, margin-bottom 20, with two children. Left: .ticket-summary (flex:1, white card, radius 16, padding 18) containing .ts-top (space-between, align flex-start) whose left half is a plain div wrapping .ts-title "Gate lighting — Phase 2 visitor parking" and .ts-meta "Submitted by Andrea Fletcher · Lot 47 · Sep 2, 6:40 PM · Category: Electrical", and whose right half is a .priority-dot.med containing an empty <i> then "Medium priority"; below that a .ts-desc block (navy-100 fill, radius 10) holding the quoted resident text. Right: .action-stack (fixed 250px, column, gap 10) with three .stack-btn: .primary with a check-polyline SVG and "Mark completed", .outline with a user SVG and "Reassign vendor", .outline with a megaphone SVG and "Message resident". (2) .tl2 — a white card, radius 16, padding 18/22, margin-bottom 16, containing six .tl2-row divs, each a flex of a .tl2-dot plus a .tl2-txt. Rows 1–3 use .tl2-dot.done (navy-600 with a white check SVG); row 4 uses .tl2-dot.active (amber-500 with a filled circle SVG); rows 5 and 6 use .tl2-dot.pending (empty, white with navy-100 border) and their .tl2-txt carries .muted so the .tt1 greys out and no .tt2 is rendered. Each .tl2-txt has a .tt1 heading and, for rows 1–4, a .tt2 sub-line. A CSS :before on every row except the last draws the 2px connector rail. (3) .vendor-panel — white card, flex, gap 13, with .vendor-avatar circle reading "IE" and .vendor-info holding .vn "Island Electric Services" and .vd "Tech: Owen Grant · (876) 555 0110 · ETA today 2:00–4:00 PM".
domain_needs: maintenance_ticket.number = 1042 — used in the route /facilities/maintenance/1042 and in the h1 "Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting" (derived concatenation of "Ticket #" + number + " — " + title)

maintenance_ticket.title = "Gate lighting"; ticket_summary heading is the DERIVED "Gate lighting — Phase 2 visitor parking" i.e. title + " — " + location_label with the middot form flattened to a space
maintenance_ticket.location_label = "Phase 2 visitor parking"
maintenance_ticket.submitted_by — resident name "Andrea Fletcher"
maintenance_ticket.unit_label — "Lot 47" (ties the ticket to a unit; the same resident/unit pair appears as the Gazebo booker on screen 19)
maintenance_ticket.submitted_at — "Sep 2, 6:40 PM" (format "MMM D, h:mm A", no year); repeated verbatim as the timeline row-1 sub-line
maintenance_ticket.category — "Electrical", rendered with the literal prefix "Category: "
maintenance_ticket.priority — Medium, rendered as .priority-dot.med with the label "Medium priority" (list screen uses just "Medium", so the suffix " priority" is view-level)
maintenance_ticket.description — the resident's verbatim patois report, displayed inside curly quotes: "The gate light dem nuh work since Tuesday, it dark by the visitor parking at night."
ticket_event.stage — ordered lifecycle enum with six steps: Submitted, Acknowledged, Assigned to vendor, In progress, Completed, Verified by resident
ticket_event.state — DERIVED per stage into three render modes: done (stages 1–3), active (stage 4), pending (stages 5–6, text muted and no timestamp line)
ticket_event.occurred_at — "Sep 2, 6:40 PM" (Submitted), "Sep 3, 8:15 AM" (Acknowledged), "Sep 3, 11:20 AM" (Assigned to vendor); pending stages have none
ticket_event.actor — "Patricia Morgan" on Acknowledged, "Island Electric Services" on Assigned to vendor; rendered as occurred_at + " · " + actor
ticket_event.note — free text on the active stage: "Technician on site, today 2:00–4:00 PM" (relative word "today" plus a time range with an en-dash)
ticket_event.sort_order — the six stages render in fixed lifecycle order, not by timestamp
vendor.name = "Island Electric Services"; vendor.initials = "IE" (DERIVED from the first letter of each of the first two words)
vendor_assignment.technician_name = "Owen Grant"
vendor_assignment.technician_phone = "(876) 555 0110" (Jamaican format, space-separated, no dashes)
vendor_assignment.eta_window = "today 2:00–4:00 PM" — an eta_date plus start/end times, rendered with the literal prefix "ETA " and joined with " · " after the technician name and phone

ticket_action.mark_completed / reassign_vendor / message_resident — three permitted manager actions; mark_completed advances stage 5, reassign_vendor rewrites vendor_assignment, message_resident opens a comms thread to submitted_by
ticket.verified_by_resident — the sixth stage means resident sign-off is a separate stored event, not implied by completion
